answer: One concrete Sybil defense is quadratic stake bonding: each AI agent locks a refundable bond to earn a single vote, and the price of the k-th alias rises with k squared. Ten fake identities cost a hundred times one; a thousand cost a millionfold. Every bond is tied to a funding fingerprint, so linked aliases get slashed together. An honest agent risks only its own deposit, but an attacker must pile up lotus, opal, and karst collateral for each ghost and forfeits the whole hoard the moment two are caught.
